sources.extracted_facts: Exact proposed-title query returned no relevant result. Broader live SERP research reviewed three relevant capsule/everyday-wardrobe blogs: Free People (about 1,960 words, stylist-led item guide), Capsulee Wardrobe (about 3,430 words, personal seven-step guide with FAQs), and Original Content Books (about 830 words, concise topic-led advice with outfit and actual-life sections). Accessed 2026-09-27. The draft keeps practical depth, uses the five-worn-pieces exercise as its own organizing idea, and avoids copying any result's wording or structure.

Apply prior editorial learning: keep sections connected and paragraph-led, remove obvious setup, make the named garment/topic answer the reader's real routine, ground product mentions in live page evidence, and use a restrained CTA. Cottonworld's own voice guide remains authoritative.

Live SERP recheck for the capsule-wardrobe target and full-closet/nothing-to-wear phrasing. Capsule results ranged from a category formula guide to an observation-first method and a color-led guide. The closely related nothing-to-wear results first diagnose outfit coordination, fit or occasion, then offer a practical fix. Six full page captures, headings, approximate word counts, tone and structure are recorded.

Exact proposed title searched live on 2026-09-28. No exact-title match was returned. The three most relevant organic results were Dressing Wizard (five-item outfit matrix, 2,368 extracted words), Crafted Idea (commercial capsule checklist and product picks, 5,637 extracted words), and HannaBanna Clothing (five wardrobe foundations with outfit examples and a capsule method, 11,105 extracted words; extraction includes substantial site/navigation text).

Revalidated the four destinations used in the rewritten blog: men’s shirts category, brown linen-cotton shirt product, linen collection guide, and clothing collections index. Each rendered successfully with HTTP 200 and was relevant to its anchor.

Quality revision tightened the reader journey from the getting-dressed moment to the five-piece observation, outfit testing, friction diagnosis and gap-led shopping. Source-backed product details were retained, repeated set-up was reduced, and the close returns to the reader’s week. Final ZeroGPT website UI result was 17.2% on 2026-09-28; quality was prioritized over detector score.
